2607.09417.title: SVF-CR: Synchronized Visual-Facial Cross-Refinement for Multimodal Ambivalence and Hesitancy Recognition
2607.09417.paper_summary: Ambivalence and hesitancy are subtle behavioral states that are expressed through a combination of verbal content, facial behavior, visual context, and acoustic cues. Effective recognition therefore requires not only extracting informative unimodal representations, but also modeling how temporally aligned behavioral evidence interacts across modalities. In this paper, we propose a synchronized visual-facial cross-refinement framework (SVF-CR) with pairwise multimodal evidence fusion for ambivalence and hesitancy recognition. The proposed method first extracts whole-video segment tokens and cropped-face segment tokens using the same temporal partition. The synchronized visual and facial tokens are refined through intra-modal self-attention and bidirectional visual-facial cross-attention, allowing whole-video context and local facial behavior to mutually refine each other before evidence construction. We then construct segment-level visual-facial evidence using consistency and discrepancy modeling, followed by temporal self-attention and attention pooling. Textual and acoustic features are lightly refined through context self-attention and are fused with the enhanced visual-facial evidence at the final decision stage using pairwise evidence fusion. Experiments on the BAH (Behavioral Ambivalence/Hesitancy) public evaluation split show that the proposed synchronized visual-facial cross-refinement improves public macro-F1 over both global visual-face token fusion and synchronized evidence baselines, achieving a public macro-F1 of 0.7156. Code is available at : https://github.com/hiinnnii/BAH-Challenge-ECCV2026\_SVF-CR.
2607.09417.paper_summary_zh: 模糊和猶豫是通過語言內容、面部行為、視覺背景和聲音線索的組合表達的微妙行為狀態。因此，有效的識別不僅需要提取信息豐富的單一模態表示，還需要建模時間對齊的行為證據如何在不同模態之間互動。在本文中，我們提出了一種同步視覺-面部交叉細化框架（SVF-CR），用於模糊和猶豫的識別，並進行成對的多模態證據融合。所提出的方法首先使用相同的時間劃分提取整個視頻段標記和裁剪的面部段標記。同步的視覺和面部標記通過模態內自注意力和雙向視覺-面部交叉注意力進行細化，允許整個視頻上下文和局部面部行為在證據構建之前相互細化。我們然後使用一致性和差異性建模構建段級視覺-面部證據，隨後進行時間自注意力和注意力池化。文本和聲音特徵通過上下文自注意力進行輕微細化，並在最終決策階段使用成對證據融合與增強的視覺-面部證據進行融合。在BAH（行為模糊/猶豫）公共評估拆分上的實驗表明，所提出的同步視覺-面部交叉細化在公共宏F1上超過了全球視覺-面部標記融合和同步證據基線，達到公共宏F1為0.7156。代碼可在此獲得：https://github.com/hiinnnii/BAH-Challenge-ECCV2026\_SVF-CR。
